method: Every pair of finishes in the same start-screened edition of at least 1,000 finishes (3,969,514 finishes) within 5 seconds of each other at 5, 10, 15 and 20K, grouped by the finish the earlier 20K split projects (20K time × 42.195/20); for the 2:45–3:15 group, the section in which each pair parted (first more than 5 seconds apart at the mat that ends it) or that it stayed within 5 seconds to the finish. Across groups, the share still within 5 seconds at every later mat rises with the projected finish. A pack of k finishes gives k(k−1)/2 pairs, so the same five groups were also counted per finish (finishes with such a partner that kept one to the finish) and per edition (the median edition of 100+ pairs): the order of the groups is the same.
